headline: Power Backup Report for Smith County
summary: Homes in Smith County face a high outlook. They see a long outage of 12 hours or more about once every 4 years. This comes from 8 years of records since 2018. In one storm from June 2024, 56% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth went without power for about 57 hours. In January 2023, 33% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth went without power for about 79 hours. One Core lasts about 13 hours in August. One Core lasts about 29 hours in February. Two Cores last about 21 hours in August. Two Cores cover 80% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
